scenes.text: In 4,372, what is the value of the thousands digit? Let us think carefully. The digit in that place is worth 4,000. The answer is 4000. Great work!
In 6,805, what is the value of the hundreds digit? Let us think carefully. The digit in that place is worth 800. The answer is 800. Great work!
In 9,134, what is the value of the tens digit? Let us think carefully. The digit in that place is worth 30. The answer is 30. Great work!
In 2,057, what is the value of the ones digit? Let us think carefully. The digit in that place is worth 7. The answer is 7. Great work!
